{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Whyb8LVx3jXvs9twouWQQg","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t/**\n2\t * Platform-wide invariant — INFRA-CRITICAL-021 (DEFECT-1):\n3\t *\n4\t * Importing `@aquaculture/backend-common` (the MAIN barrel) MUST NOT\n5\t * load `@Entity()` decorators as a side effect.\n6\t *\n7\t * The main barrel is consumed by every microservice, often just for\n8\t * cross-cutting utilities (TenantGuard, RedisModule, factories). If the\n9\t * barrel chains through entity files, every consumer service ends up\n10\t * with `AuditLogEntity`, `UserConsent`, and `GdprDataRequest` registered in\n11\t * TypeORM's global metadata storage —\n12\t * which then surfaces in `dataSource.entityMetadatas` and trips the\n13\t * `SchemaDriftValidator` on services that never opted into those\n14\t * domains.\n15\t *\n16\t * # Architectural contract\n17\t *\n18\t * - `libs/backend-common/src/index.ts` MUST NOT have any\n19\t *   `export * from './audit'`, `export * from './finding-registry'`, or\n20\t *   transitive re-export that pulls in those subdirectories.\n21\t *\n22\t * - `libs/backend-common/src/security/index.ts` MUST NOT have any\n23\t *   `export * from './gdpr'` (which would chain through GDPR entities\n24\t *   and re-pollute via `index.ts → security → gdpr → entities`).\n25\t *\n26\t * - Concrete entity-bearing modules (`AuditLogModule`, `GdprModule`) are\n27\t *   reachable via deep import paths only. The finding-registry deep import is\n28\t *   a pure replay contract; its persistence module belongs exclusively to\n29\t *   `event-store-service`:\n30\t *     - `@aquaculture/backend-common/audit`\n31\t *     - `@aquaculture/backend-common/gdpr`\n32\t *     - `@aquaculture/backend-common/finding-registry` (pure contract only)\n33\t *\n34\t * # What this invariant detects\n35\t *\n36\t * - Direct re-export reintroductions in the two index files.\n37\t * - Files inside `libs/backend-common/src/` that import from\n38\t *   `./audit`, `./security/gdpr`, or `./finding-registry` AND whose\n39\t *   import path is reachable from the main `index.ts` graph (i.e.\n40\t *   transitive contamination via a non-entity utility file).\n41\t *\n42\t * Test directories are exempt — they may import the entity modules\n43\t * directly for fixtures.\n44\t */\n45\t\n46\timport { readFileSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs';\n47\timport { resolve } from 'node:path';\n48\t\n49\tconst REPO_ROOT = resolve(__dirname, '..', '..');\n50\tconst BACKEND_COMMON_SRC = resolve(REPO_ROOT, 'libs/backend-common/src');\n51\t\n52\tconst FORBIDDEN_RE_EXPORTS = [\n53\t  // path -> forbidden patterns inside that file\n54\t  {\n55\t    file: 'index.ts',\n56\t    patterns: [\n57\t      /^\\s*export\\s+\\*\\s+from\\s+['\"]\\.\\/audit['\"]\\s*;?$/m,\n58\t      /^\\s*export\\s+\\*\\s+from\\s+['\"]\\.\\/finding-registry['\"]\\s*;?$/m,\n59\t    ],\n60\t  },\n61\t  {\n62\t    file: 'security/index.ts',\n63\t    patterns: [/^\\s*export\\s+\\*\\s+from\\s+['\"]\\.\\/gdpr['\"]\\s*;?$/m],\n64\t  },\n65\t];\n66\t\n67\t// Files inside backend-common that are themselves part of the main\n68\t// barrel chain (reachable from index.ts) — they MUST NOT directly import\n69\t// entity-bearing submodules. Add to this list when adding new top-level\n70\t// exports to `index.ts`.\n71\tconst MAIN_BARREL_GUARD_FILES = [\n72\t  'guards/tenant.guard.ts',\n73\t  'guards/roles.guard.ts',\n74\t  'guards/tenant-permission.guard.ts',\n75\t  'guards/service-identity.guard.ts',\n76\t  'guards/token-revocation.service.ts',\n77\t  'middleware/tenant-context.middleware.ts',\n78\t  'middleware/tenant-schema.middleware.ts',\n79\t  'database/index.ts',\n80\t  'security/security.module.ts',"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"bd3775bd-fa24-4b1e-ba75-d2841f63ccfe","uuid":"9bf0d15e-57c7-444b-aa36-b41f4ed5f513","timestamp":"2026-09-21T02:25:49.721Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/gharunner/actions-runner/_work/aquaculture_platform/aquaculture_platform/aria-worktrees/req-AIR-aria-evidence-judge-db7c3a856378/tests/invariants/no-shared-entity-decorators-via-main-barrel.spec.ts","content":"/**\n * Platform-wide invariant — INFRA-CRITICAL-021 (DEFECT-1):\n *\n * Importing `@aquaculture/backend-common` (the MAIN barrel) MUST NOT\n * load `@Entity()` decorators as a side effect.\n *\n * The main barrel is consumed by every microservice, often just for\n * cross-cutting utilities (TenantGuard, RedisModule, factories). If the\n * barrel chains through entity files, every consumer service ends up\n * with `AuditLogEntity`, `UserConsent`, and `GdprDataRequest` registered in\n * TypeORM's global metadata storage —\n * which then surfaces in `dataSource.entityMetadatas` and trips the\n * `SchemaDriftValidator` on services that never opted into those\n * domains.\n *\n * # Architectural contract\n *\n * - `libs/backend-common/src/index.ts` MUST NOT have any\n *   `export * from './audit'`, `export * from './finding-registry'`, or\n *   transitive re-export that pulls in those subdirectories.\n *\n * - `libs/backend-common/src/security/index.ts` MUST NOT have any\n *   `export * from './gdpr'` (which would chain through GDPR entities\n *   and re-pollute via `index.ts → security → gdpr → entities`).\n *\n * - Concrete entity-bearing modules (`AuditLogModule`, `GdprModule`) are\n *   reachable via deep import paths only. The finding-registry deep import is\n *   a pure replay contract; its persistence module belongs exclusively to\n *   `event-store-service`:\n *     - `@aquaculture/backend-common/audit`\n *     - `@aquaculture/backend-common/gdpr`\n *     - `@aquaculture/backend-common/finding-registry` (pure contract only)\n *\n * # What this invariant detects\n *\n * - Direct re-export reintroductions in the two index files.\n * - Files inside `libs/backend-common/src/` that import from\n *   `./audit`, `./security/gdpr`, or `./finding-registry` AND whose\n *   import path is reachable from the main `index.ts` graph (i.e.\n *   transitive contamination via a non-entity utility file).\n *\n * Test directories are exempt — they may import the entity modules\n * directly for fixtures.\n */\n\nimport { readFileSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs';\nimport { resolve } from 'node:path';\n\nconst REPO_ROOT = resolve(__dirname, '..', '..');\nconst BACKEND_COMMON_SRC = resolve(REPO_ROOT, 'libs/backend-common/src');\n\nconst FORBIDDEN_RE_EXPORTS = [\n  // path -> forbidden patterns inside that file\n  {\n    file: 'index.ts',\n    patterns: [\n      /^\\s*export\\s+\\*\\s+from\\s+['\"]\\.\\/audit['\"]\\s*;?$/m,\n      /^\\s*export\\s+\\*\\s+from\\s+['\"]\\.\\/finding-registry['\"]\\s*;?$/m,\n    ],\n  },\n  {\n    file: 'security/index.ts',\n    patterns: [/^\\s*export\\s+\\*\\s+from\\s+['\"]\\.\\/gdpr['\"]\\s*;?$/m],\n  },\n];\n\n// Files inside backend-common that are themselves part of the main\n// barrel chain (reachable from index.ts) — they MUST NOT directly import\n// entity-bearing submodules. Add to this list when adding new top-level\n// exports to `index.ts`.\nconst MAIN_BARREL_GUARD_FILES = [\n  'guards/tenant.guard.ts',\n  'guards/roles.guard.ts',\n  'guards/tenant-permission.guard.ts',\n  'guards/service-identity.guard.ts',\n  'guards/token-revocation.service.ts',\n  'middleware/tenant-context.middleware.ts',\n  'middleware/tenant-schema.middleware.ts',\n  'database/index.ts',\n  'security/security.module.ts',","numLines":80,"startLine":1,"totalLines":147}}}

Uncertainty is a VALID arbitration\n        # outcome, for the arbiter alone, with a reason from the closed\n        # vocabulary; binary judges stay bound to binary verdicts.\n        reason = verdict_block.get(\"uncertainty_reason\")\n        if (\n            role == \"consensus_arbitration\"\n            and verdict is None\n            and reason in CONSENSUS_UNCERTAINTY_REASONS\n        ):\n            pass\n        else:\n            errors.append(f\"judge_verdict.verdict:invalid:{verdict!r}\")\n    tool_id = request.get(\"tool_id\") or verdict_block.get(\"tool_id\")\n    run_id = request.get(\"run_id\") or verdict_block.get(\"run_id\")\n    finding_id = request.get(\"finding_id\") or verdict_block.get(\"finding_id\")\n    if not (tool_id and run_id and finding_id):\n        errors.append(\"judge_verdict:missing_tool_run_or_finding_id\")\n    judge_id = details.get(\"agent_subagent_type\") or verdict_block.get(\"judge_id\")\n    if not judge_id:\n        errors.append(\"judge_verdict:missing_judge_identity\")\n    elif str(judge_id).startswith(\"ci-executor:\"):\n        errors.append(\"judge_verdict:executor_shaped_judge_identity\")\n    return errors\n\n\ndef record_judge_verdict_from_response(\n    *,\n    request: dict[str, Any],\n    response: dict[str, Any],\n    base_dir: str | Path | None = None,\n) -> dict[str, Any] | None:\n    \"\"\"Translate an ACCEPTED judge response into an ai_judge feedback row.\n\n    Returns the persisted row, or None when the envelope role is not a\n    judge role (the bridge is a no-op for non-judge submissions).\n\n    Raises GovernanceError when the response is missing the data the\n    consensus engine requires (tool_id / run_id / finding_id come from\n    the request envelope's optional fields; verdict + severity from\n    the response.details).\n    \"\"\"\n    role = response.get(\"role\")\n    if not is_judge_role(role):\n        return None\n\n    # Y5 (ORPHAN-706) — one contract, two consumers: the executor's\n    # pre-submit gate checks exactly this list and releases instead of\n    # sealing an unfoldable accepted result; the bridge raises on it so a\n    # row that somehow slipped past still fails loudly, never half-folds.\n    contract_errors = validate_judge_response(request=request, response=response)\n    if contract_errors:\n        raise GovernanceError(\n            \"judge bridge contract violation: \" + \"; \".join(contract_errors)\n        )\n\n    details = response.get(\"details\") or {}\n    if not isinstance(details, dict):\n        details = {}\n\n    # ORPHAN-CRITICAL-735 — the arbiter's legitimate non-verdict outcome\n    # folds through the SAME producer, ledger and idempotent escalation_id\n    # as the deterministic engine, so one sweep drains both lanes into one\n    # HUMAN_REQUIRED record. It is NOT a feedback verdict: an uncertain\n    # arbitration must never write an ai_judge row.\n    if role == \"consensus_arbitration\":\n        arb_block = _verdict_field(details)\n        arb_reason = arb_block.get(\"uncertainty_reason\")\n        if arb_block.get(\"verdict\") is None and arb_reason in CONSENSUS_UNCERTAINTY_REASONS:\n            from .feedback_store import record_consensus_uncertainty\n\n            row = record_consensus_uncertainty(\n                tool_id=str(request.get(\"tool_id\") or arb_block.get(\"tool_id\") or \"\"),\n                run_id=str(request.get(\"run_id\") or arb_block.get(\"run_id\") or \"\"),\n                finding_id=str(request.get(\"finding_id\") or arb_block.get(\"finding_id\") or \"\"),\n                group_id=str(request.get(\"judgment_group_id\") or arb_block.get(\"group_id\") or \"\"),\n                reason=str(arb_reason),\n                cycle_id=request.get(\"cycle_id\"),\n                base_dir=base_dir,\n            )\n            return {\"kind\": \"consensus_uncertainty\", **row}\n    verdict_block = _verdict_field(details)\n\n    tool_id = request.get(\"tool_id\") or verdict_block.get(\"tool_id\")\n    run_id = request.get(\"run_id\") or verdict_block.get(\"run_id\")\n    finding_id = request.get(\"finding_id\") or verdict_block.get(\"finding_id\")\n    if not (tool_id and run_id and finding_id):\n        raise GovernanceError(\n            \"judge bridge requires tool_id, run_id, finding_id in request or response.details.verdict; \"\n            f\"got tool_id={tool_id!r}, run_id={run_id!r}, finding_id={finding_id!r}\"\n        )\n\n    # Typed-judgment plan — a typed block folds through the typed parser:\n    # the verdict is its value, the confidence its top-label probability,","numLines":130,"startLine":179,"totalLines":499}}}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_013bkmhp2CaZ3LQoHqqUhHqA","type":"tool_result","content":"2290\t    #\n2291\t    # WHY: claude -p stream-json emits JSONL events\n2292\t    # ({\"result\": \"...\", \"total_cost_usd\": ..., ...}) where the agent's final message may contain the\n2293\t    # actual aria/agent-response/v1 envelope as fenced ```json``` block\n2294\t    # or as final JSON block. Writing raw JSONL to output_path means\n2295\t    # kernel submit-result reads runtime telemetry instead of the envelope,\n2296\t    # which fails:\n2297\t    #   response_schema: missing required fields:\n2298\t    #     ['$schema', 'request_id', 'claim_id', 'agent_id', 'role',\n2299\t    #      'status', 'satisfaction_matrix']\n2300\t    #\n2301\t    # HOW: parse JSONL, extract the final message, find the embedded\n2302\t    # envelope JSON, INJECT mandatory identity fields ($schema,\n2303\t    # request_id, claim_id, agent_id, role, status) from the known\n2304\t    # ci_executor context (these aren't the agent's job — the agent\n2305\t    # only knows its plan content), synthesize a satisfaction_matrix\n2306\t    # from must_satisfy with verdict=satisfied when the agent omitted\n2307\t    # it, then write the corrected envelope to output_path.\n2308\t    #\n2309\t    # Tier hierarchy: Tier-2 (Make it automatic) — the envelope shape\n2310\t    # is now produced correctly by default; agents don't have to know\n2311\t    # internal kernel identity fields.\n2312\t    if completed.stdout:\n2313\t        envelope = _build_envelope_from_claude_output(\n2314\t            raw_stdout=completed.stdout,\n2315\t            request_id=request_id,\n2316\t            claim_id=claim_id or \"\",\n2317\t            agent_id=agent_id or \"\",\n2318\t            role=role,\n2319\t            subagent_type=subagent_type,\n2320\t            must_satisfy=must_satisfy or [],\n2321\t            # ARIA-MEDIUM-171 — the rung that answered, not the frontmatter.\n2322\t            dispatch_model=completed.model or agent_profile.model,\n2323\t            usage=completed.usage,\n2324\t        )\n2325\t        envelope[\"details\"][\"agent_contract_hash\"] = agent_contract.contract_hash\n2326\t        output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n2327\t        _write_sanitized_envelope(output_path, envelope)\n2328\t        resolved_transcript_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n2329\t        resolved_transcript_path.write_text(completed.stdout, encoding=\"utf-8\")"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"bd3775bd-fa24-4b1e-ba75-d2841f63ccfe","uuid":"640765be-7e9c-4918-9ffa-715cdb909f70","timestamp":"2026-09-21T02:27:32.306Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/gharunner/actions-runner/_work/aquaculture_platform/aquaculture_platform/aria-worktrees/req-AIR-aria-evidence-judge-db7c3a856378/tools/aria-poc/ci_executor.py","content":"    #\n    # WHY: claude -p stream-json emits JSONL events\n    # ({\"result\": \"...\", \"total_cost_usd\": ..., ...}) where the agent's final message may contain the\n    # actual aria/agent-response/v1 envelope as fenced ```json``` block\n    # or as final JSON block. {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_0198puqnGquBuf9TZQc7G9Dm","type":"tool_result","content":"2584\tdef _build_envelope_from_claude_output(\n2585\t    *,\n2586\t    raw_stdout: str,\n2587\t    request_id: str,\n2588\t    claim_id: str,\n2589\t    agent_id: str,\n2590\t    role: str,\n2591\t    subagent_type: str,\n2592\t    must_satisfy: list[dict[str, Any]],\n2593\t    dispatch_model: str | None = None,\n2594\t    usage: dict[str, Any] | None = None,\n2595\t    confidence_source: str = \"self_reported\",\n2596\t) -> dict[str, Any]:\n2597\t    \"\"\"Convert ``claude -p stream-json`` JSONL into a kernel-valid envelope.\n2598\t\n2599\t    ``confidence_source`` is the ROUTE's word on where a judge's confidence\n2600\t    came from (typed-judgment plan, ARIA-HIGH-167): every CLI and chat\n2601\t    completion in the fleet reports the model's own number\n2602\t    (``self_reported``); a typed decision transport that returns\n2603\t    probabilities natively stamps ``provider_reported``. Stamped\n2604\t    unconditionally, like the dispatch model: the bridge reads the stamp and\n2605\t    ignores any spelling the model wrote inside its payload.\n2606\t\n2607\t    ``usage`` is the run result's own usage block when the caller holds one\n2608\t    (ARIA-HIGH-161): the Z.ai transport reports usage on the result, not as\n2609\t    a stream-json event, so parsing ``raw_stdout`` alone left the\n2610\t    cross-vendor rung's envelope without ``claude_cli_usage`` and the native\n2611\t    wrapper released a finished verdict as ``usage_unavailable``. The stream\n2612\t    parse stays the fallback for a caller that has only the bytes.\n2613\t\n2614\t    Claude Code emits JSONL events. ARIA keeps those raw events out of\n2615\t    artifacts, extracts the final agent message, and injects the\n2616\t    lease-bound identity fields that the agent cannot know.\n2617\t    \"\"\"\n2618\t    events = parse_claude_jsonl(raw_stdout)\n2619\t    agent_text = extract_final_message(events)\n2620\t    if not agent_text:\n2621\t        agent_text = raw_stdout\n2622\t    extracted = _extract_envelope_json(agent_text) or {}\n2623\t\n2624\t    envelope: dict[str, Any] = {\n2625\t        \"$schema\": \"aria/agent-response/v1\",\n2626\t        \"request_id\": request_id,\n2627\t        \"claim_id\": claim_id,\n2628\t        \"agent_id\": agent_id,\n2629\t        \"role\": role,\n2630\t        \"status\": str(extracted.get(\"status\") or \"submitted\"),\n2631\t    }\n2632\t\n2633\t    matrix_in = extracted.get(\"satisfaction_matrix\")\n2634\t    if isinstance(matrix_in, list) and matrix_in:\n2635\t        envelope[\"satisfaction_matrix\"] = matrix_in\n2636\t    else:\n2637\t        # Synthesize from must_satisfy so the kernel's non-empty-matrix\n2638\t        # check passes — as UNVERIFIED rows (ARIA-AUDIT-024). The agent\n2639\t        # being invoked and replying is transport evidence, not a\n2640\t        # satisfaction judgment; the verdict belongs to an independent\n2641\t        # judge reading this matrix, never to the executor that carried\n2642\t        # the reply.\n2643\t        synthesized: list[dict[str, Any]] = []\n2644\t        excerpt = (agent_text or \"<agent produced no text>\").strip()\n2645\t        excerpt_short = excerpt[:240] + (\"...\" if len(excerpt) > 240 else \"\")\n2646\t        if must_satisfy:\n2647\t            for item in must_satisfy:\n2648\t                if not isinstance(item, dict):\n2649\t                    continue\n2650\t                cid = item.get(\"id\")\n2651\t                if not cid:\n2652\t                    continue\n2653\t                synthesized.append({\n2654\t                    \"id\": cid,\n2655\t                    \"verdict\": \"unverified\",\n2656\t                    \"evidence_refs\": [],\n2657\t                    \"evidence\": excerpt_short,\n2658\t                })\n2659\t        if not synthesized:\n2660\t            # Last-resort single-row matrix; agent_text is the only\n2661\t            # truthful evidence. Without this, the kernel rejects with\n2662\t            # evidence_satisfaction_matrix_must_be_non_empty.\n2663\t            synthesized.append({\n2664\t                \"id\": f\"agent-text-{request_id[-8:]}\",\n2665\t                \"verdict\": \"unverified\",\n2666\t                \"evidence_refs\": [],\n2667\t                \"evidence\": excerpt_short,\n2668\t            })\n2669\t        envelope[\"satisfaction_matrix\"] = synthesized\n2670\t\n2671\t    # Carry through any agent-supplied evidence_refs / details / notes.\n2672\t    for passthrough in (\"evidence_refs\", \"details\", \"notes\", \"plan_content\"):\n2673\t        if passthrough in extracted and extracted[passthrough] is not None:\n2674\t            envelope[passthrough] = extracted[passthrough]\n2675\t    if \"evidence_refs\" not in envelope:\n2676\t        envelope[\"evidence_refs\"] = []\n2677\t\n2678\t    # Embed the raw agent text under details so operators have full\n2679\t    # forensic context post-submission.\n2680\t    details = envelope.get(\"details\")\n2681\t    if not isinstance(details, dict):\n2682\t        details = {}\n2683\t    # D1 (Kapalı Döngü) — FORCE-set, not setdefault: this field is now the\n2684\t    # judge's calibration identity (judgment_bridge reads it as judge_id),\n2685\t    # and a setdefault would let the agent's own payload spoof another\n2686\t    # judge's identity into the per-judge precision ledger.\n2687\t    details[\"agent_subagent_type\"] = subagent_type\n2688\t    # ORPHAN-HIGH-781 — the dispatch-resolved model, same doctrine as\n2689\t    # agent_subagent_type above: FORCE-set from the runtime profile the\n2690\t    # executor resolved at invocation time. The judge's own\n2691\t    # verdict.model self-report remains in the payload as data, but the\n2692\t    # kernel's anchor distinct-model count must not trust a string the\n2693\t    # judged agent wrote about itself — a misreported model silently\n2694\t    # satisfies or violates ANCHOR_MIN_DISTINCT_MODELS, which is exactly\n2695\t    # the guarantee that field exists to provide.\n2696\t    # ARIA-MEDIUM-171 — the route's word, never the agent's: a named model\n2697\t    # overwrites whatever the agent wrote under the key, and a route that\n2698\t    # named nothing REMOVES the key rather than leaving the agent's spelling\n2699\t    # in place (ORPHAN-HIGH-781 pinned \"no stale stamp\" for the absent case).\n2700\t    if dispatch_model:\n2701\t        details[\"agent_dispatch_model\"] = dispatch_model\n2702\t    else:\n2703\t        details.pop(\"agent_dispatch_model\", None)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"bd3775bd-fa24-4b1e-ba75-d2841f63ccfe","uuid":"f693ca8a-0899-494d-8f95-85d675a85335","timestamp":"2026-09-21T02:27:41.417Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/gharunner/actions-runner/_work/aquaculture_platform/aquaculture_platform/aria-worktrees/req-AIR-aria-evidence-judge-db7c3a856378/tools/aria-poc/ci_executor.py","content":"def _build_envelope_from_claude_output(\n    *,\n    raw_stdout: str,\n    request_id: str,\n    claim_id: str,\n    agent_id: str,\n    role: str,\n    subagent_type: str,\n    must_satisfy: list[dict[str, Any]],\n    dispatch_model: str | None = None,\n    usage: dict[str, Any] | None = None,\n    confidence_source: str = \"self_reported\",\n) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Convert ``claude -p stream-json`` JSONL into a kernel-valid envelope.\n\n    ``confidence_source`` is the ROUTE's word on where a judge's confidence\n    came from (typed-judgment plan, ARIA-HIGH-167): every CLI and chat\n    completion in the fleet reports the model's own number\n    (``self_reported``); a typed decision transport that returns\n    probabilities natively stamps ``provider_reported``. Stamped\n    unconditionally, like the dispatch model: the bridge reads the stamp and\n    ignores any spelling the model wrote inside its payload.\n\n    ``usage`` is the run result's own usage block when the caller holds one\n    (ARIA-HIGH-161): the Z.ai transport reports usage on the result, not as\n    a stream-json event, so parsing ``raw_stdout`` alone left the\n    cross-vendor rung's envelope without ``claude_cli_usage`` and the native\n    wrapper released a finished verdict as ``usage_unavailable``. The stream\n    parse stays the fallback for a caller that has only the bytes.\n\n    Claude Code emits JSONL events. ARIA keeps those raw events out of\n    artifacts, extracts the final agent message, and injects the\n    lease-bound identity fields that the agent cannot know.\n    \"\"\"\n    events = parse_claude_jsonl(raw_stdout)\n    agent_text = extract_final_message(events)\n    if not agent_text:\n        agent_text = raw_stdout\n    extracted = _extract_envelope_json(agent_text) or {}\n\n    envelope: dict[str, Any] = {\n        \"$schema\": \"aria/agent-response/v1\",\n        \"request_id\": request_id,\n        \"claim_id\": claim_id,\n        \"agent_id\": agent_id,\n        \"role\": role,\n        \"status\": str(extracted.get(\"status\") or \"submitted\"),\n    }\n\n    matrix_in = extracted.get(\"satisfaction_matrix\")\n    if isinstance(matrix_in, list) and matrix_in:\n        envelope[\"satisfaction_matrix\"] = matrix_in\n    else:\n        # Synthesize from must_satisfy so the kernel's non-empty-matrix\n        # check passes — as UNVERIFIED rows (ARIA-AUDIT-024). The agent\n        # being invoked and replying is transport evidence, not a\n        # satisfaction judgment; the verdict belongs to an independent\n        # judge reading this matrix, never to the executor that carried\n        # the reply.\n        synthesized: list[dict[str, Any]] = []\n        excerpt = (agent_text or \"<agent produced no text>\").strip()\n        excerpt_short = excerpt[:240] + (\"...\" if len(excerpt) > 240 else \"\")\n        if must_satisfy:\n            for item in must_satisfy:\n                if not isinstance(item, dict):\n                    continue\n                cid = item.get(\"id\")\n                if not cid:\n                    continue\n                synthesized.append({\n                    \"id\": cid,\n                    \"verdict\": \"unverified\",\n                    \"evidence_refs\": [],\n                    \"evidence\": excerpt_short,\n                })\n        if not synthesized:\n            # Last-resort single-row matrix; agent_text is the only\n            # truthful evidence.
